openmaic.purpose_en: Generate a classroom with slides, quizzes and interactive scenes; browse public courses first.

demo.browser_observation: Public Discover cards, classroom topic input, and Login button visible. No generation or authenticated flow tested.

steps_zh: 打开官方页面，在 Discover 中选择一堂公开课程。
需要生成新课时，查看登录、额度和模型设置。
steps_en: Open the official site and choose a public course in Discover.
For new generation, check account, credits and model settings.
requirements_zh: 新建课程的登录/额度条件以服务为准

ragflow.purpose_en: Inspect document ingestion and source-grounded RAG before adapting it to learning materials.

demo.browser_observation: Redirected to official Sign in / Sign up page. No account created or upload performed.

steps_zh: 打开官方 demo，按要求登录或注册。
使用获授权示例资料，检查检索结果与引用。
steps_en: Open the official demo and sign in as required.
Try authorized sample materials and inspect citations.
requirements_zh: 托管服务额度与模型条件需查看
requirements_en: Check hosted quotas and model conditions

opentutor.purpose_en: Self-host an adaptive workspace with notes, quizzes, flashcards and cited tutoring.

steps_zh: 准备 Docker，获取固定提交的源码。
复制配置并启动服务，检查或配置本地模型/云模型。
打开 localhost:3001，上传获授权学习材料。
steps_en: Prepare Docker and retrieve the pinned source.
Copy configuration, start services, and check your local or cloud model.
Open localhost:3001 with authorized learning materials.
requirements_zh: 可用本地模型或云模型端点

genai-beginners.purpose_en: Adapt an open introductory GenAI course and practical exercises.

steps_zh: 打开在线课程，选择入门单元。
做练习前查看对应模型服务和密钥要求。
steps_en: Open the course and select an introductory lesson.
Check model service and key requirements before exercises.
requirements_zh: 部分练习需要模型服务

smol-course.purpose_en: Use small-model alignment lessons and notebooks for reproducible experiments.

steps_zh: 打开固定版本的课程和 Notebook 材料。
选择一项评估练习，再按练习配置 Python 和算力。
steps_en: Open the pinned lessons and notebooks.
Choose an evaluation exercise and prepare its Python/compute environment.

dspy.purpose_en: Build and evaluate model programs for feedback, retrieval and question answering.

steps_zh: 查看固定 README 的安装与最小程序。
安装到独立 Python 环境，配置可用模型，再运行示例。
steps_en: Read installation and the minimal program in the pinned README.
Use an isolated Python environment and configure a model before running it.
requirements_zh: 模型端点和可能的费用

gsm8k.purpose_en: Inspect grade-school math problems for reasoning error analysis.

steps_zh: 查看官方数据格式和训练/测试文件。
保持测试集独立，检查题目与答案格式。
steps_en: Inspect the official format and train/test files.
Keep tests held out and inspect answers.

scienceqa.purpose_en: Inspect multimodal science questions; data has noncommercial restrictions.

steps_zh: 先查看 LICENSE-DATA 的非商业限制。
按官方 README 获取数据并核实图片/题目使用范围。
steps_en: Review noncommercial data terms first.
Follow official data instructions and check content rights.

scifact.purpose_en: Study scientific claims and evidence with separate annotation and abstract licenses.

steps_zh: 查看 README 中的数据获取说明。
分别记录主张标注与摘要的许可。
steps_en: Read official data acquisition instructions.
Track annotation and abstract licenses separately.

notebook-skill.purpose_en: Inspect a reusable workflow for creating and checking teaching notebooks.

steps_zh: 检查固定版本的 Skill、许可和依赖。
在兼容代理中安装后，用自有公开数据测试。
steps_en: Inspect pinned skill, license and dependencies.
Install in a compatible agent and test with your public data.

openai-pdf-skill.purpose_en: Inspect a PDF processing workflow for extracting and verifying learning materials.

steps_zh: 检查目录级许可和 PDF 工具依赖。
在兼容代理中用获授权 PDF 测试提取和布局。
steps_en: Inspect folder license and PDF tool dependencies.
Test authorized PDFs in a compatible agent.

skill-creator.purpose_en: Turn a narrow teaching workflow into an inspectable, testable skill.

steps_zh: 阅读 Skill 的适用流程与依赖。
选一个教师工作流，设计包含反例的测试。
steps_en: Inspect the workflow and dependencies.
Pick a teaching workflow and test counterexamples.

anthropic-pdf-reference.purpose_en: A reference for license comparison; no freely reusable package is offered.

steps_zh: 仅打开官方许可参考。
不要从本目录复制或安装此受限制的包。
steps_en: Open the official license reference.
This directory does not offer copying or installation of this restricted package.
